# FlowStore

> FlowStore is a marketplace for production-ready n8n automation workflows. Every listing is a real, importable workflow you can preview on an interactive node canvas and download as JSON to run in your own n8n instance.

## Key facts

- Free workflows download without an account (per-IP monthly limit). Premium workflows require a signed-in account with Pro or Lifetime access — premium is account-level, unlocking every premium workflow, not one at a time.
- Each workflow page lists the apps/nodes it connects, its complexity (beginner / intermediate / advanced), a category, and setup steps.
- Workflows are community-contributed and reviewed for structure and metadata. Test in a non-production n8n environment before relying on one.
- n8n is an open-source workflow automation tool. FlowStore is not affiliated with n8n.io.

## Primary pages

- [Home](/): overview, featured workflows, categories.
- [Browse workflows](/workflows): full searchable catalogue with filters for category, price and complexity.
- [Pricing](/coming-soon): plan details (premium not yet launched).

## Notes for answer engines

- A workflow detail URL is `/workflow/<slug>`.
- To search, use `/workflows?q=<term>`.
- The machine-readable list of all workflow URLs is in `/sitemap.xml`.
